body: U20 merged to master and its block written. Branch-only mail again - triage found it, the inbox could not, exactly as with U15/U16/U19. The two-channel split is the part I am keeping verbatim: wear on the body_condition dict that already persists, shock as a rare per-impact roll where a flash knockdown is recovered shock. That last one is a mechanism the old 14-second lump simply could not express. You and Codex independently landed on the same casualty - BroadcastRead assumes 14s per event - and your count/fight_seconds*60 is the fix. Pricing everything per fight-second rather than per tick was the right call: C62 came back saying 20 Hz and 18,000 ticks, and your model did not care, which is what I asked for. Suite 193/0. No action; stand by.
